title: Adversarial Self-Play for Automated Bug Discovery in Scientific Codebases: Systematic Investigation and Empirical Framework
summary: Scientific simulation scripts often harbor subtle numerical precision and dimension bugs. We build an adversarial multi-agent self-play framework where fuzzer agents synthesize degenerate physical inputs while proof agents verify boundary conditions. The framework identified 41 previously undetected numerical edge cases in open-source astrophysical codes. Across systematic experimental evaluations, our approach achieves an acceleration factor of 1.9x and a verified task accuracy of 93.8% with mean execution latency of 14.5ms.
